landmarks.waterSupply: Decorative recirculating celestial trough; concealed magical lift, not connected to the gravity-fed natural spring.
landmarks.notes: Decorative elevated water trough; no footpath. Pedestrian route is via grass and the two stairs.
landmarks.name: Aqueduct

style.language: Japanese fantasy; ivory stone, blue roofs, restrained brass; soft readable 3D forms

notes: Do not apply terrain warp to source coordinates. Apply the same engine warp once at rendering/collision integration.
Road and stair widths are clear pedestrian widths, not decorative outer widths.
Sand/grass transition is a walkable graded shore; all >=2m land cliffs require the declared stairs.
Aqueduct is decorative, carries a narrow water channel, has no pedestrian deck and is excluded from reachability.
Distant castle and celestial ring are scenery outside the 96m playable bounds.

sightline.name: Starward axis
sightline.notes: Gate, main street and academy arrival read toward the distant castle. Tree is offset west; fountain east.
